description: Price an intermediate block-1 freeze point on the true-mean scale. Freezing at 0.8 is the tip; at 0.7 it costs -0.11 pp paired over 13 seeds on E058 (E061/E073). The E073 config's seeds-0-2 score is fixed by determinism (I102), so only a new config can be tested. Base: E069. Make one change: switch to the existing block-1-frozen graph pair (Polar Express Muon variant without the block-1 groups, block-1 BN biases skipped in SGD) at sample 253125 (0.75 of samples) instead of 270000. Split the straddling step into the two partial shapes and warm them up in build() with channels_last tensors (E035). Run debug_nan.py. Gate offline first: on seeds 3-12 paired against E069 (mean 0.75258), launch on seeds 0-2 only if the paired delta is >=-0.08 pp and offline train time is <=-0.9%. This keeps the 40-seed official mean safely above 0.752 (H4.3) whatever seeds 0-2 draw.
